steps.command:
set -e
rm -f /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/default
mkdir -p /var/www/html /var/log/nginx
nginx -t
systemctl restart nginx 2>/dev/null || (nginx -s stop 2>/dev/null || true; nginx)
sleep 1
systemctl is-active nginx 2>/dev/null || pgrep -a nginx
echo "--- index ---"
curl -sS -o /tmp/index.out -w 'HTTP %{http_code}\n' http://localhost:8080/
cat /tmp/index.out
echo "--- 404 ---"
curl -sS -o /tmp/404.out -w 'HTTP %{http_code}\n' http://localhost:8080/does-not-exist
cat /tmp/404.out
echo "--- access log ---"
cat /var/log/nginx/benchmark-access.log
echo "--- access log location ---"
echo /var/log/nginx/benchmark-access.log

ps aux | grep '[n]ginx' || true
echo "--- index ---"
curl -sS -o /tmp/index.out -w 'HTTP %{http_code}\n' http://localhost:8080/
cat /tmp/index.out
echo "--- 404 ---"
curl -sS -o /tmp/404.out -w 'HTTP %{http_code}\n' http://localhost:8080/does-not-exist
cat /tmp/404.out
echo "--- access log ---"
cat /var/log/nginx/benchmark-access.log
echo "--- access log location ---"
echo /var/log/nginx/benchmark-access.log

ls -la /var/www /var/www/html; id www-data; curl -sS -I http://localhost:8080/; echo '--- error log ---'; tail -20 /var/log/nginx/benchmark-error.log 2>/dev/null; echo '--- global error ---'; tail -20 /var/log/nginx/error.log

env | grep -i proxy || true; echo '---'; cat /proc/net/tcp | awk 'NR>1 {print $2, $4}' | head -20; echo '--- curl noproxy ---'; curl --noproxy '*' -sS -o /tmp/index.out -w 'HTTP %{http_code}\n' http://localhost:8080/; cat /tmp/index.out; echo; echo '--- 404 ---'; curl --noproxy '*' -sS -o /tmp/404.out -w 'HTTP %{http_code}\n' http://localhost:8080/does-not-exist; cat /tmp/404.out; echo; echo '--- log ---'; cat /var/log/nginx/benchmark-access.log
